problem:
Which of the following matrices are transformed into the $2\times 2$ identity matrix after applying the row operations ${R}_{1}↔{R}_{2}\,$ and $\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1}?$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 2 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
